findings.finding: Prominent shark jawbone arch behind the landlord is not specified in the storyboard and can distract from the primary action.
findings.visible_evidence: A large semicircular jaw with many pointed teeth frames the landlord behind the bar, spanning from counter to ceiling.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the oversized shark jawbone behind the bar. Replace with understated shelves and a cracked-glass curios case as background dressing. Keep the two-shot focus on Ishmael and the landlord and preserve clear bottom-center negative space for the caption.

findings.finding: Top-right caption zone is busy, leaving no clean negative space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The top-right contains the landlord at a workbench using a plane, scattered shavings, and wall/window details.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose so the top-right quadrant is a clean, uncluttered plaster wall with subdued texture and no props or figures. Shift the landlord and workbench lower-right/mid-right, and keep shavings away from the top-right.

findings.finding: Ishmael is shown simply curled on the bench; the chair extension and his recoil from the failed bench-bed are not depicted.
findings.visible_evidence: No chair is placed to extend the bench, and Ishmael appears to be lying still rather than recoiling or giving up on the attempt.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a simple wooden chair pulled up to the bench end to fake extra length. Pose Ishmael mid-abandonment: half-rising, clutching his coat against a chill, feet slipping off the too-short setup, face grimacing. Keep the landlord in the background lowering the plane rather than actively planing to avoid stealing focus.

findings.visible_evidence: No plain tallow candle or holder is visible anywhere in the room.
findings.repair_prompt: Place a plain tallow candle in a small brass or tin holder on a nearby shelf or table edge, modest flame, no readable labels.

findings.finding: Wood shavings are confined to the workbench area, not near the bench as cued.
findings.visible_evidence: Shavings curl around the landlord’s table on the right; the floor around the bench is clean.
findings.repair_prompt: Sprinkle a few light wood shavings near the bench base to tie the scene together, keeping them sparse to avoid cluttering the caption zone.

findings.finding: Cross-drafts are only implied by the window; no rickety door is visible to suggest meeting draughts.
findings.visible_evidence: A single loose-looking window is shown; no door is in frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Include a slightly ajar, rickety door on the opposite wall from the window to hint at crossing drafts; keep wind effects subtle and avoid exaggerated motion.

findings.finding: Bottom-left caption zone is not clean; a barrel and stool occupy the reserved area, and the wall texture there is visually busy.
findings.visible_evidence: A barrel and a small stool sit in the lower-left corner with mottled wall and floor texture behind/around them.
findings.repair_prompt: Clear the bottom-left quadrant for captioning by removing or shifting the barrel and stool out of that area and simplifying the wall/floor texture to a smooth, darker gradient. Preserve the current character poses and lighting.

findings.finding: The corner wall clock indicating the late hour is not clearly visible.
findings.visible_evidence: Background shows shelves with bottles and a timber post, but no distinct wall clock face or case can be discerned.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a simple shadowed wall clock near the corner behind the characters with hands suggesting a late hour; keep numerals indistinct to avoid readable text.

findings.finding: Detail of a stick shaving catching on the landlord’s fingers is not apparent.
findings.visible_evidence: Wood curls are visible on the counter, but his fingers appear clean without a shaving caught on them.
findings.repair_prompt: Place a small curled shaving lightly caught on Peter Coffin’s fingers while he whittles, maintaining the current wry expression and pose.

findings.finding: Papered fireboard, listed as a visible prop, is not shown.
findings.visible_evidence: Room walls are bare except for a door at right and gear at left; no fireplace opening or papered panel is visible anywhere in the frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a simple fireplace on one wall closed by a thin papered fireboard with non-readable patterned paper; keep it subdued and in background, maintain clean top-center caption space, and avoid any readable imagery or text.

findings.finding: Harpoon is displayed across the fireplace mantel instead of standing by the bed as a background prop.
findings.visible_evidence: A long iron harpoon lies horizontally on the mantel above the hearth and candle.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the harpoon from the mantel; if included at all, place a tall iron harpoon upright at the bed’s head as a background element, or omit it for this frame.

findings.finding: Tomahawk-pipe and seal-skin wallet on a sea chest are missing despite being specified supporting visuals.
findings.visible_evidence: No tomahawk-shaped pipe, wallet, or sea chest is visible near the bed or hearth; only a chair with the grego and a seaman’s bag are present.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a sea chest near the bed with a tomahawk-shaped pipe and a small seal-skin wallet resting on it; keep them unobtrusive.

findings.finding: Papered fireboard set aside is not shown.
findings.visible_evidence: Open hearth with andirons and a small blaze, but no thin papered fireboard panel propped nearby.
findings.repair_prompt: Include a thin, printed-paper-covered fireboard panel leaned to one side of the fireplace with no readable imagery.

findings.finding: Biscuit used to tend the small blaze is not visible.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg kneels and reaches toward the fire, but no biscuit is shown in hand or within reach.
findings.repair_prompt: Depict a small hard biscuit in Queequeg’s hand or set at the hearth’s edge as he tends the shavings.

findings.finding: Extra set-dressing not in contract (wooden chest with coiled rope and glass bottles) may confuse prop continuity around the seaman’s bag.
findings.visible_evidence: Lower-left foreground shows a wooden chest with thick rope draped over it; two bottles sit on the left dresser.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the wooden chest and bottles, or push them into deep shadow. If a luggage prop is desired, replace with a soft-sided, weathered canvas sea-bag cinched with rope.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s skin tone does not show the described purplish-yellow cast.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg is rendered with a medium brown tone under warm light without the specified purplish-yellow hue.
findings.repair_prompt: Grade Queequeg’s skin toward a subtle purplish-yellow cast while keeping his dark square tattoo patterns distinct.

findings.finding: Specified ash flecks from the pipe are not visible on the blanket.
findings.visible_evidence: Despite smoke from the tomahawk-pipe, the blanket surface near the bowl appears clean with no specks.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a few tiny, nonsparking ash flecks on the blanket beneath the pipe bowl; keep them subtle so they don’t draw focus.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s skin tone does not reflect the specified purplish-yellow cast.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg’s exposed torso and face appear medium brown under the candlelight, though the square tattoo grid is correct.
findings.repair_prompt: Shift Queequeg’s overall skin tone toward a purplish-yellow cast while preserving the existing dark square tattoo patterns and candlelit shading; keep all other elements unchanged.

findings.finding: Bottom-center caption area may be slightly busy with blanket folds and Ishmael’s hands close above it.
findings.visible_evidence: The lower center shows textured bedding with a narrow soft vignette band; the hands and folds approach the intended caption zone.
findings.repair_prompt: Increase clean negative space by extending the soft vignette upward in the bottom-center and simplifying blanket folds there to ensure clear caption placement.
